title: Nagi's Sweet Potato Bake
ingredients: Coat/Season: 30g melted butter, 2 tbsp olive oil, 2 garlic cloves minced, 1 tbsp chopped rosemary, 3/4 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp pepper
Extra: 1 tbsp olive oil for brushing, plus extra rosemary for garnish
steps: Preheat oven to 180°C. Brush skillet base and sides lightly with olive oil.
Place potato slices in a large bowl. Add melted butter, 1 tbsp olive oil, garlic, rosemary, salt, and pepper, tossing well to coat.
Layer the potato slices in the skillet in a circular, overlapping pattern.
Cover with foil and bake for 30 minutes until the potatoes are almost fully cooked.
Remove foil, increase oven temp to 220°C, and brush potatoes with the remaining 1 tbsp olive oil.
Bake uncovered for 20 minutes until golden and crisp. Garnish with fresh rosemary and serve immediately.
